name: jk42_oem770t_gearhead_noload
status: fitted to one bench session, not independently validated
description: JK42 BLDC motor + OEM770T drive + two-stage planetary gearhead (~13.75:1), no output load. Three effective bodies: motor plus first sun, first carrier plus second sun, second carrier plus output. Stage parameters are fitted placeholders, not measured gearbox mechanics. See docs/jk42_oem770t_gearhead_noload.md.

source.captures: simset, sq, ripdir, backlash (fit); readme_jk (same-session holdout); F103, 2026-11-26
source.method: Real analog-servo Control.c/Signal.c/MotionQueue.c/MotionReference.c, planner-lead-10ms with fast-planner flags. Differential-evolution topology search and warm-start three-body refinement, including a post-move creep penalty.
source.reproduction: analog-servo experiments/motion-planner/gearhead-multibody/reproduction.tar.gz; refined-three-body.json records parameters, checks, and initial population

units.position: All bodies in motor-reflected encoder counts: 4000 per motor revolution, 54989 per output revolution measured. Feedback is body 0. Divide the output body's coordinate by 54989 for output revolutions.
units.reflection: Physical downstream inertia is divided by cumulative speed-reduction ratio squared when reflected to the motor; fitted body inertias are already reflected.
units.force: analog-servo firmware torque units, axis frame, full scale +-32767; not measured current or N m
units.ripplePhase: Relative to simset's encoder zero; recalibrate phase for another encoder zero.
units.backlashGap: Half-gap in motor-reflected counts, not physical output counts
units.analogChain: Per CALL: run analogStepsPerTick analog calls per tick, each followed by SimmyChainStepDt(..., 1.0/analogStepsPerTick).
